paper_anchor: Definition 4.1; LaTeX label def:reg_mixing_time; ar5iv anchor S4.Thmtheorem1
exact_statement: Define tau_delta = min{t in N_0 | m rho^t <= delta}, where delta in (0,1), under sup_mu0 d_TV(P_pi^t mu_0, mu_pi) <= m rho^t for all t in N_0.
domain: finite irreducible aperiodic Markov chains with geometric TV envelope constants m>0 and rho in (0,1)
quantifiers: all initial state distributions in the worst-case TV deviation
machine_contract: On refresh chains P=rho I+(1-rho)1 pi^T, exhaust every delta-state initial distribution and require direct worst-case TV first crossing to equal min{t:m rho^t<=delta} for the predeclared n/rho/delta grid.
pass_condition: All 60 rows agree, every chain assumption audit passes, and the off-by-one control is rejected on all 60 rows.
failure_exit: python -m td_repro exits nonzero if the contract fails
